record.question:
Rewrite the following sentences as directed:
(a) A fair little girl sat ____________ a tree. (insert preposition)
(b) No man can serve two masters. (separate the subject and the predicate)
(c) Muslims fast in the month of Ramzan. (name the part of speech of the italisized word)
(d) Clouds float in the sky because they are ____________ than air. (insert appropriate degree of comparison)
(e) He is ____________honour to this profession. (insert appropriate article)
(f) He will finish the work in a fortnight. (change the voice)
(g) I am hoping to get a holiday soon. (name the tense of the underlined verb)
